stories.title: Piden de 4 a 12 años de cárcel para equipo médico que atendió a Maradona antes de morir

en.title: Prosecution seeks 4 to 12 years prison for medical team that treated Maradona before his death
en.summary: Argentine prosecutors have requested prison sentences of up to 12 years for members of the medical team responsible for Diego Maradona's care in his final days. The trial resumed this year following a 2025 scandal that required restarting judicial proceedings, with closing arguments now underway.

stories.title: Hallan los cuerpos de un hombre y una mujer con indicios de muerte violenta en Valverde de Júcar

en.title: Bodies of man and woman found with signs of violent death in Valverde de Júcar
en.summary: A 37-year-old woman and her partner were discovered dead with evidence of violence in a Valverde de Júcar home in Cuenca. The government's gender-based violence unit is investigating whether the deaths constitute femicide.

stories.title: La Fiscalía pide 12 años de cárcel para el médico que atendió antes de su muerte a Maradona

en.title: Prosecution seeks 12 years prison for doctor who treated Maradona before his death
en.summary: Prosecutors are requesting a 12-year prison sentence for a doctor and 4 to 10 years for other team members who treated Diego Maradona following surgery for a subdural hematoma.

stories.title: La Guardia Civil investiga como violencia machista el hallazgo de los cuerpos de un hombre y una mujer en Valverde de Júcar (Cuenca)

en.title: Civil Guard investigates as gender-based violence the discovery of bodies of man and woman in Valverde de Júcar
en.summary: The Civil Guard is investigating the deaths of a couple as potential gender-based violence. The couple had two daughters aged 6 and 14, and no prior records of domestic violence were documented.

stories.title: El Tribunal Supremo tumba el decreto de universidades del Gobierno contra la privada

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court strikes down Government decree on private universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court has invalidated the Government's decree that tightened criteria for creating and authorizing private universities. The Balearic Islands' education authority, which challenged the regulation, won the case.

stories.title: Anne Carson, tras conocer el Nobel de Literatura: "La poesía es más útil que la prosa ahora, porque todo el mundo tiene prisa. Es buena porque es breve"

en.title: Anne Carson, after learning of Literature Nobel: "Poetry is more useful than prose now, because everyone is in a hurry. It is good because it is brief"
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in Literature but initially missed several calls from the Swedish Academy informing her of the award.

stories.title: El Supremo anula el real decreto de Universidades que endurecía los criterios para los centros privados por falta de justificación para su tramitación urgente

en.title: Spain's Supreme Court annuls university decree that tightened criteria for private institutions due to lack of justification for expedited processing
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court invalidated a government education decree after finding the Council of Ministers irregularly accelerated the approval process. The court sided with the Balearic Islands, which challenged the decree.

stories.title: El Supremo tumba el decreto del Gobierno para frenar las universidades ‘chiringuito’

en.title: The Supreme Court strikes down the Government's decree to stop sham universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court unanimously rejected a government decree on universities, determining that the urgent processing procedure was not properly justified despite not ruling on the decree's substance.

stories.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature

en.title: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Anne Carson, a Canadian poet, received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her innovative and creative contributions that established new literary forms and approaches.

stories.title: El Supremo anula el decreto que endurecía los requisitos para crear universidades privadas

en.title: Supreme Court annuls decree tightening requirements for creating private universities
en.summary: Spain's Supreme Court has overturned a decree that made it harder to establish private universities, accepting an appeal from the regional government of Marga Prohens based on procedural defects in its processing.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana el Premio Nobel de Literatura 2026

en.title: Anne Carson wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian poet Anne Carson has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature for her bold and inventive work that creates new forms for contemporary literature in dialogue with classical tradition.

stories.title: Anne Carson gana el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: The Swedish Academy has recognized Canadian poet Anne Carson for her audacious and inventive work that creates new literary forms through dialogue with classical tradition.

stories.title: Una rama de la familia Puig sale de Flamasats

en.title: One branch of the Puig family exits Flamasats
en.summary: Marc Puig Guasch and his siblings sold their stake in the company owning Clipper lighters and Alpino pencils, divesting a 25% holding they controlled at the end of the previous year.

stories.title: La industria militar alista a las pymes catalanas

en.title: Military industry enlists Catalan small and medium enterprises
en.summary: Defense companies are encouraging Catalan industrial businesses to participate in major defense ministry programs, advocating for consortia arrangements where each company has a defined role to enter the sector.

stories.title: Bruselas descarta dar más flexibilidad fiscal a los países por la crisis energética

en.title: Brussels rules out greater fiscal flexibility for countries due to energy crisis
en.summary: European Commission Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis rejected requests from Greece and Italy for additional fiscal flexibility, arguing that granting it would undermine the credibility of spending rules and that fiscal sustainability remains vital.

stories.title: BME asegura que está preparado para facilitar la conexión para la cotización dual

en.title: BME confirms it is prepared to facilitate connection for dual listing
en.summary: Spain's stock exchange operator BME stated that modifications to regulations enable one of the identified methods for companies to list on both markets simultaneously.

stories.title: Los ingresos anualizados de OpenAI son un 30% inferiores a lo anunciado

en.title: OpenAI's annualized revenues are 30% lower than announced
en.summary: OpenAI's annualized sales are approximately 50 billion dollars, roughly 30 percent below figures the ChatGPT owner recently communicated to investors, according to Financial Times reporting.
